text:
nina: Quick pass on the compact onboarding modal I showed this morning. Ran 6 usability reps. Two main problems: CTA stacking on phones and some a11y voiceover issues.

raj: thanks. can you paste the prototype link?

nina: https://drive.company/internal/designs/compact-onboard-v4.png — prototype is v4.

tim: saw the layout on narrow widths: primary CTA + secondary link sit inline and wrap unpredictably. suggestion: mobile = primary full-width, secondary as underlined text below. desktop = inline.

elaine: voiceover note: when modal opens SR announces "dialog" then reads heading — but also announces the close button twice. I suspect focus lands on close, then JS moves focus to heading. We should set initial focus to the first actionable element (primary CTA) and ensure only one focus event.

nina: agree. prefer focus to go to primary CTA so keyboard users can start the sample immediately.

tim: stepper control: current dots are decorative only. People wanted to jump between steps. Replace with small numbered buttons (aria-label="Step 1: choose sample") and set aria-controls to the panel ids. Dots can remain visually but aria-hidden.

raj: copy micro suggestions (short list):
- headline: "Launch a sample"
- subline: "Run a curated example in your workspace in under a minute"
- primary CTA: "Launch"
- secondary: "Open checklist"
Which reads best?

nina: prefer those. "Launch" feels action-focused and avoids confusion with signup CTAs that use "Get started".

elaine: color/contrast: sample meta (small label under title) is 12px grey on grey and fails 4.5:1. Use token `content-strong` or bump to 14px.

tim: dark mode visual: the "1-min demo" pill has a 2px light border that causes subtle banding. Remove border in dark mode and increase vertical padding to 6px for legibility.

elaine: accessibility extras: add `aria-live="polite"` region for the copy-to-clipboard action on failed runs. Also ensure the copy button exposes `aria-label="Copy error text"`.

nina: empty-state/run-fail copy proposal (friendly + actionable):
"Run failed 13 Something went wrong while executing the sample. Try again, or open the checklist to run locally. Copy the error and paste it in support if you need help."
Include a small `Copy error` button and a link to docs.

raj: telemetry: can ops-bot add events `onboard_compact_open`, `onboard_compact_launch`, `onboard_compact_fail` with properties `{ sample_slug, is_new_user }`? would like timestamps and error_code for fail.

ops-bot: Logged. I will create provisional analytics events. Need sample_slug mapping from product and a boolean for `is_new_user` (account_age_minutes < 1440).

tim: reduced motion: step transitions should respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and fallback to instant content swap. Also test on VoiceOver rotor navigation.

nina: small UX nit: secondary inline link text currently says "View setup checklist" while other surfaces use "Open checklist". Let's be consistent and use "Open checklist" everywhere.

elaine: keyboard outlines: primary and secondary lack `:focus-visible` style parity. Add 3px outline matching design token `focus-ring` and ensure high contrast in dark mode.

nina: action items:
- raj: update copy tokens and wire `Launch` CTA into component props (due Thu)
- tim: replace dots with accessible step buttons + reduced-motion support (PR by Fri)
- elaine: a11y checklist updates (focus behavior, aria-live, copy-button labels) and run NVDA/VoiceOver passes (by next Tue)
- ops-bot: provisional analytics events deployed to staging (ETA 2 days)

raj: I'll drop updated copy into the GH issue and attach the new mock.

nina: thanks all. can we also run 5 quick unmoderated tests on the new copy/flow before we A/B? design ops can schedule.

ops-bot: design-ops pinged for scheduling.

nina: ending thread."
